How Cold Brew Coffee Is Made

By Daniel Okoye, barista trainer

Published February 3, 2026, updated March 1, 2026

What is cold brew?

Cold brew is coffee steeped in cold or room-temperature water for twelve to twenty-four hours, which produces a smooth, low-acidity concentrate.

Cold extraction yields fewer acidic compounds than hot brewing.
